units.source_text: 我决定和无精打采的拉卟一起去逛街。

en.t: I decided to go out into town with the listless Lapp.

units.source_text: 络绎不绝的大街两侧，成行的山毛榉树的树荫下依旧是井井有条排列的 各种各样的商店。

en.t: On both sides of the busy avenue, under the shade of rows of beech trees, all kinds of shops were still lined up in orderly fashion.

units.source_text: 这个时候，留着长发的诗人托喀走了过来。

en.t: At that moment, the long-haired poet Tokku came walking toward us.
